title: Sonarr imports samples when downloading new series without runtime info and video file is in archive
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

I have had an ongoing issue where when a new series first comes out that was already added to Sonarr, when it downloads the initial episodes, it will import the samples instead of the main video file. This happens when the torrent contains the main video file as packed rar files along with a sample video file.

### Expected Behavior

Sonarr should ignore the sample

### Steps To Reproduce

Download a torrent for a tv show that includes a sample video file where the main video file right as the show first airs before the series runtime gets populated

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Synology DSM 7
- Sonarr: 4.0.14.2939
- Docker Install: 
- Using Reverse Proxy: No
- Browser: 
- Database: Sqlite 3.48.0
```

### What branch are you running?

Main

### Trace Logs?

2025-03-28 17:26:11.9|Debug|AcceptableSizeSpecification|Beginning size check for: Mid-Century.Modern.S01E02.DV.HDR.2160p.WEB.H265-SuccessfulCrab
2025-03-28 17:26:11.9|Debug|AcceptableSizeSpecification|Series runtime is 0, but all episodes in release aired within 24 hours of first episode in season, defaulting runtime to 45 minutes
2025-03-28 17:26:11.9|Debug|AcceptableSizeSpecification|Item: Mid-Century.Modern.S01E02.DV.HDR.2160p.WEB.H265-SuccessfulCrab, meets size constraints
2025-03-28 17:30:27.4|Debug|DetectSample|[/data/torrents/completed/Mid-Century.Modern.S01E02.DV.HDR.2160p.WEB.H265-SuccessfulCrab/Sample/mid-century.modern.s01e02.dv.hdr.2160p.web.h265-successfulcrab-sample.mkv] does not appear to be a sample. Runtime 00:01:04.4380000 seconds is more than minimum of 15 seconds
2025-03-28 17:30:27.5|Debug|EpisodeFileMovingService|Attempting to hardlink episode file: /data/torrents/completed/Mid-Century.Modern.S01E02.DV.HDR.2160p.WEB.H265-SuccessfulCrab/Sample/mid-century.modern.s01e02.dv.hdr.2160p.web.h265-successfulcrab-sample.mkv to /data/media/tv/Mid-Century Modern (2025) {imdb-tt32641461}/Season 01/Mid-Century Modern (2025) - S01E02 - Working Girls [WEBDL-2160p][DV HDR10Plus][EAC3 5.1][h265]-SuccessfulCrab.mkv
2025-03-28 17:30:27.5|Trace|ConfigService|Using default config value for 'usescriptimport' defaultValue:'False'
2025-03-28 17:30:27.5|Debug|DiskTransferService|HardLinkOrCopy [/data/torrents/completed/Mid-Century.Modern.S01E02.DV.HDR.2160p.WEB.H265-SuccessfulCrab/Sample/mid-century.modern.s01e02.dv.hdr.2160p.web.h265-successfulcrab-sample.mkv] > [/data/media/tv/Mid-Century Modern (2025) {imdb-tt32641461}/Season 01/Mid-Century Modern (2025) - S01E02 - Working Girls [WEBDL-2160p][DV HDR10Plus][EAC3 5.1][h265]-SuccessfulCrab.mkv]

### Anything else?

I believe this is the same issue as #6180.

Attaching a screenshot of the import details from Sonarr UI and the video file details.

I’ve included what I think are the relevant parts from the trace Log file, since there is a lot in it I don’t think is relevant to the issue. Let me know if there is something more needed.

I’ve tried to take a look at what might be going wrong with the code. I think it has to do with the fact that IsSatisfiedBy() correctly knows that the series runtime info hasn’t been populated yet, so it uses 45 min within the function, but doesn’t update the series info, so then in DetectSample, series runtime is still 0, so GetMinimumAllowedRuntime thinks it is an anime episode (since 0 is less than 3) and sets the threshold to 15 seconds.

I suspect this would be fixed by either adding a check to GetMinimumAllowedRuntime For 0 runtime and use a longer time when the runtime is 0, or for IsSatisfiedBy to see the series runtime to a default instead of leaving at 0
author: belgarth

comments.body: Looks like `DetectSample` is missing the fallback logic to 45 mins from [AcceptableSizeSpecification](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/8c67a3bdee65aa35bdd82ac8614be875236d88de/src/NzbDrone.Core/DecisionEngine/Specifications/AcceptableSizeSpecification.cs#L48-L65) when series runtime is 0.
